description: Read the vendor portal settings, as Setup > Vendor portal shows them: the tenant default for sharing the demand forecast with suppliers (Off; Forecast; or ForecastAndOrderTiming, which adds the estimated next order), how many months ahead a shared forecast reaches, and the profile fields suppliers must fill in. Optional supplier (id or exact name) adds that supplier's own override and the level that applies to it. Change them with set_vendor_forecast_sharing; see what a supplier would see with preview_vendor_forecast. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential and an Admin user.

supplier.description: Optional supplier id (GUID) or exact name.

name: get_vendor_portal_settings
title: Vendor Portal Settings
